PRE-RUN REVIEW

Checking configuration

Select the build used for your simulation. This is not detected automatically.

Export & run

Place the exported file beside your original configuration so relative paths still resolve.

For the bundled example, save as tuned.config in HotSpot/examples/example1, then run there:

../../hotspot -c tuned.config \
  -f ev6.flp -p gcc.ptrace \
  -materials_file example.materials \
  -steady_file tuned.steady
For imported projects, use your own input filenames. Review existing run scripts for overriding flags.
Running submits the configuration to this workspace. Configurations and results are saved on its disk. HotSpot documentation
